v16-8.display:
Give thanks unto the Lord; call upon Him by His name;
make His works known among peoples.

v16-9.display:
Sing unto Him and hymn Him;
recount to everyone His wonders, which the Lord has done.

v16-10.display:
Praise in His holy name;
the heart seeking His good pleasure shall rejoice.

v16-11.display:
Seek the Lord and be strengthened;
seek His face continually.

v16-12.display:
Remember His wonders which He has done,
portents and judgments of His mouth,

v16-13.display:
you offspring of Israel, His servants,
sons of Jacob His chosen ones.

v16-14.display:
He is the Lord our God;
His judgments are throughout all the earth.

v16-15.display:
He remembers His covenant for ever,
His word which He commanded for a thousand generations,

v16-16.display:
which He established with Abraham,
and His oath to Isaac.

v16-17.display:
He established it for Jacob as an ordinance,
for Israel as an everlasting covenant,

v16-18.display:
saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan,
the measured allotment of your inheritance,”

v16-19.display:
when they became few in number,
as they were made small and dwelt as strangers in it.

v16-20.display:
They traveled from nation to nation,
from a kingdom to another people.

v16-21.display:
He allowed no man to overpower them
and reproved kings on their account:

v16-22.display:
“Do not touch My anointed ones,
and do not act wickedly against My prophets.”

v16-23.display:
Sing unto the Lord, all the earth;
proclaim His salvation from day to day.

v16-25.display:
For the Lord is great and greatly to be praised;
He is fearsome above all the gods.

v16-26.display:
For all the nations’ gods are idols,
but our God made heaven.

v16-27.display:
Glory and praise are before Him;
strength and boasting are in His place.

v16-28.display:
Give unto the Lord, ancestral families of the nations;
give to the Lord glory and strength.

v16-30.display:
Let all the earth fear before Him;
let the earth be set right and not be shaken.

v16-31.display:
Let heaven be glad and the earth exult;
let them say among the nations, “The Lord reigns!”

v16-32.display:
The sea shall resound with its fullness,
and the tree of the field and everything in it.

v16-33.display:
Then the trees of the forest shall be glad before the Lord,
for He has come to judge the earth.

v16-34.display:
Give thanks unto the Lord, for it is good,
for His mercy endures for ever.

v16-35.display:
Say, “Save us, O God of our salvation,
and rescue us from the nations,
that we may praise Thy holy name
and glory in Thy praises.”

v16-36.display:
Blessed be the Lord, Israel’s God, from age to age!
All the people shall say, “Amen.”
And they praised the Lord.
